en: A black‑and‑white image showing a formal town garden or small park with curving gravel paths, circular flowerbeds, low hedges, and mature trees. In the background stand several late‑19th‑century brick townhouses with decorative window surrounds and high roofs. An ornate iron fence and gate structure is visible at the far right, along with old‑style street lamps. The scene is quiet, with no obvious vehicles, suggesting an early 20th‑century European urban setting.
